Software Development Engineer.description: Builds and ships production software; strongest fit for high coding + analytical skill.

Data Scientist / ML Engineer.description: Model building, statistics and experimentation; needs strong analytical + coding skill.

Product Manager.description: Bridges tech and business; thrives on communication, prioritization and market sense.

Business / Data Analyst.description: Turns data into decisions for stakeholders; needs analytical rigor + clear communication.

Core / Systems Engineer.description: Hardware-adjacent or infrastructure-heavy roles; deep technical depth over breadth.

UI/UX & Product Design.description: Designs usable, delightful interfaces; creativity + communication are the core drivers.

Higher Studies / Research (MS/PhD).description: Deep specialization via postgraduate research; analytical curiosity is the dominant trait.

Government / Public Sector (Competitive.description: Stable public-sector careers via competitive exams; consistency + discipline matter most.

Entrepreneurship / Startup Founder.description: Builds something from zero; needs a versatile blend across every axis, especially grit.
